name: Dokploy
shortDescription: Modern Docker-Based Application Deployment Platform for VPS Hosting
about: Dokploy simplifies deploying and managing Docker applications on your VPS. It provides a clean interface for managing services, domains, and SSL certificates while giving you full control of your server environment.
useCases: Startups and developers managing multiple containerized applications on a single VPS.
performance: Optimized for 4GB VPS. 8GB recommended for high-traffic applications.

whyDeploy.title: 2. Cost-Effective Scaling
whyDeploy.description: Scale resources vertically without migrating infrastructure.

whyDeploy.title: 3. Improved Reliability
whyDeploy.description: Dedicated VPS resources ensure consistent uptime and performance.
